issue.title: test_cross_test_config_reader_is_reported_as_poisoning fails under the loaded check lane, passes in isolation
issue.description:
Proposed by epic phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7 (caps-docs, note #2) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Filed by the sase-1h8.13.1.9 land agent. Not caused by sase-1h8.13.1.9: that epic changed only sase-core bead mutation/read-model code plus one docs/beads.md paragraph.

Test: `tests/test_config_reader_probe.py::test_cross_test_config_reader_is_reported_as_poisoning`. Root cause unknown. It looks load-induced: the failure appeared only under the saturated parallel lane.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in the phase's loaded sase tool run check lane on sase master: run 76866b1372fa463fd91c046ad05a348d, 2026-10-09 03:22Z, 40 min, 7 pytest workers, tree RSS peak 10.7 GiB. Phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7 reported that it passed when rerun alone on the same tree. It passed in the land agent's full escalated lane on clean master bd830064ca (run 7d658c634fd39565484d98edcae94afa, 54111 passed). Observed fail rate: 1 of 2 full lanes, 0 serial failures.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7 saw this test fail once under the loaded sase check lane, and it passed alone. No existing bead covers this node.
